paragraphs.text: Yenna is a female Elf noble and the regent of Redtooth Keep.
Yenna is distrustful and proud. She wears a cape of roses strung together with thorny vines, and her armor is adorned with flower motifs.

Yenna is the leader of the Redtooth elves, who were cursed to turn into werefoxes each night . She searched for a way to break the spell that cursed her people. When the Ardenvale knight captain Armont and her knights stumbled upon the Keep, Yenna eventually warmed to her kindness. She told Armont of an enchanted rose guarded by an archon in a glade nearby that would break the spell. Armont and Yenna ventured to the glade in search of the rose. Armont was able to break the curse. It is implied the two fell in love.
Yenna is based on the Prince/Beast of Beauty and the Beast .
